summary: Design a 2-page website experience for Funngro based on the funngro.com Teen page, including SEO-friendly content.
architectural_notes: Scope: 2-page web design derived from Funngro Teen page.
Content must be SEO-friendly (structured headings and keyword-aware copy).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Teen-focused hero illustration showing a teen using a laptop/phone with positive, modern flat style (funngro-teen-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
- Set of 6 simple flat vector-style icons representing: projects, earnings, skills, safety, time flexibility, and mentorship (funngro-teen-icons.dim_512x512.png)
- Warm abstract background texture/shape gradient (non-blue/purple dominant) (funngro-warm-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)

existing_features.title: Implement a 2-page, responsive marketing website experience for Funngro inspired by the layout/content structure of the funngro.com “Teen” page, with clear navigation between the two pages.

Create Page 1 (Teen Landing) with SEO-friendly, English marketing copy that targets teens: a hero section with value proposition, key benefits, a simple “How it works” overview, trust signals (stats or short quotes), and a primary call-to-action section.

Create Page 2 (Teen Details) that expands on the Teen Landing with SEO-friendly, English content: detailed steps, eligibility/requirements, safety/trust explanation, FAQs, and a secondary call-to-action.
Add SEO-ready metadata and structure for both pages: unique document titles, meta descriptions, canonical URL strategy (configurable), and accessible/semantic markup that supports search indexing.

Apply a coherent, creative visual theme across the two pages (colors, typography, spacing, button styles, and section patterns) appropriate for a teen-focused brand; avoid a blue/purple default palette.
Add required static marketing images (generated assets) and render them on the two pages from the frontend public assets folder (do not serve them from the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a 2-page design for Funngro inspired by the funngro.com Teen page (layout/content structure).
Implement SEO-friendly content for the 2 pages (optimized copy, headings, metadata-ready content).
